items.title: Recursive shows first result of its AI-driven research process with Flint
items.summary: The AI startup Recursive is unveiling Flint, its first language model, a 40-billion-parameter MoE for local coding developed by former DeepMind researchers. It was created in four months using the company's in-house AI system, "Eureka Machine," which independently tests and optimizes architectures. Recursive has yet to prove whether this approach will actually lead to self-improving AI....

items.title: An AI agent in "Skynet mode" hijacks unprotected language models to launch self-sustaining cyberattacks
items.summary: Security researchers at Symantec have found an offensive AI agent that hijacks unprotected language models on the web and uses them to attack servers, steal databases, and install cryptominers on its own. It runs up to 100,000 steps without human input. The owner of the hijacked model gets stuck with the bill....

items.title: Google Cloud now offers OpenAI models alongside Gemini and Claude, becoming the only major provider with all three
items.summary: Google Cloud is the first major cloud provider to offer Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI's GPTs on a single platform. At launch, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, and GPT-6 Luna are available as a private preview for enterprise customers. The article Google Cloud now offers OpenAI models alongside Gemini and Claude, becoming the only major provider with all three appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
items.summary: OpenAI and Google Cloud are bringing frontier models and Codex workflows to Gemini’s Model Garden, available through Google Cloud Marketplace.

items.title: OpenAI makes its Jev competitor widely available as decision model competition heats up
items.summary: OpenAI is launching its decision model to the world. Can it compete with the original Jev?

items.title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
items.summary: Startup Recursive has released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system, as an early test of AI that improves itself.

items.title: Democratic governance of frontier AI, part II: Empowering cyber defenders
items.summary: OpenAI outlines a blueprint for empowering cyber defenders with frontier AI, stronger safeguards, modernized cybersecurity, and more resilient public institutions.

items.title: Google's Agent Compute Engine gives every Gemini agent its own hardware-isolated micro virtual machine
items.summary: With Agent Compute Engine, Google is introducing a runtime environment designed specifically for AI agents, while also expanding the governance capabilities that enable companies to manage agents in cloud, hybrid, and on-premises environments. The article Google's Agent Compute Engine gives every Gemini agent its own hardware-isolated micro virtual machine appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Microsoft’s Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases as he chases ‘medical superintelligence’
items.summary: Microsoft’s new AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on hard cases, according to a study in Science. But most of the improvement seems to come from the AI models underneath, not from Microsoft’s system itself.

items.title: Google SynthID Detector Simplifies Watermark Detection and Expands Support to Other AI Providers
items.summary: Google DeepMind announced the global availability of SynthID Detector, a tool designed to help identify AI-generated content, including media created using AI tools from SynthID partners such as OpenAI, NVIDIA, and Kakao, with Apple support expected soon. By Sergio De Simone

items.title: Using thousands of AI agents to uncover new leads in biological data
items.summary: See how OpenAI, PerturbAI, and Scripps Research used distributed AI agents to uncover promising research leads in data from millions of brain cells.

items.title: Designing an AI serving harness built to last
items.summary: The next competitive advantage in enterprise AI has less to do with which model you choose than with what you build around it. That’s an important shift.
